page_title: Build AI teammates with Zapier Agents

summary.name: Zapier Agents
summary.one_liner: Zapier Agents is a no-code tool for building custom AI agents that use business data and perform tasks across thousands of connected apps.
use_cases: Qualify enterprise leads from web forms
Create researched content scripts for marketing
Build FAQ chatbots from docs and public links
summary.what_it_does: Zapier Agents lets users create custom AI agents, optionally with help from Zapier Copilot, that connect to business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps. Agents can be equipped with company knowledge such as FAQs, docs, and public links so a chatbot can answer questions. The page describes agents being triggered on command or running in the background, with activity monitoring and a chat interface. Data sources are synced automatically with the latest information, according to the page. A Chrome extension is mentioned in a customer testimonial.
notable: Connects to 9,000+ apps to perform tasks
Can be trained on FAQs, docs, and public links for chatbot answers
Automatically syncs with live business data
Built with help from Zapier Copilot
caveats: Page describes the product as in early access or beta, so availability may be limited
Pricing is not stated on the page
Activity-based counting for Team accounts is referenced in FAQs but details are not on the page
